method.purpose: Estimate whether modeled acoustic distances have sufficient packet delivery and scheduled throughput for swarm data needs.

message_profiles.name: oceans_admin_uplink
message_profiles.description: Paper-tracked supervisory telemetry target: one 32-byte state payload per second.

message_profiles.name: peer_contact_report
message_profiles.description: One contact/map report every 5 s with duplicate/metadata allowance.

message_profiles.name: peer_map_bundle
message_profiles.description: Bundled contact reports plus edge-quality data every 5 s.

message_profiles.name: shared_channel_8_drone_map_bundle
message_profiles.description: Eight drones sharing one half-duplex acoustic channel for map bundles.

message_profiles.name: recovery_alert
message_profiles.description: Repeated recovery/rally alert over a 15 s retry window.

classification.strong: packet_delivery_rate >= strong_pdr, channel_occupancy <= strong_occupancy, and retry_burden <= strong_retry_limit
classification.marginal: packet_delivery_rate >= marginal_pdr, channel_occupancy <= marginal_occupancy, and retry_burden <= marginal_retry_limit

model_limits: not a site-specific sound-speed profile or bathymetry model
does not model multipath geometry explicitly
does not model Doppler spread explicitly yet
does not allocate a full MAC schedule across multiple links yet
default source level is calibrated so the OCEANS admin target is plausible near 2 km

sources.name: Local OCEANS paper target
sources.detail: OCEANS26B_0177_MS-2.pdf reports a 28 kHz admin channel, 32-byte uplink payload, 1 Hz telemetry, viability up to 2 km, and 15 s retry penalty. It is used here as an admin-channel target, not as a peer-gossip channel validation.

sources.name: UnetStack BasicAcousticChannel
sources.detail: Uses Urick-style average transmission loss plus BPSK fading model; parameters include carrier frequency, bandwidth, spreading, noise level, salinity, temperature, and water depth.

sources.name: Lucani, Medard, Stojanovic 2008
sources.detail: Provides distance/capacity/power framing for underwater acoustic links with path loss dependent on distance and frequency.

sources.name: Network-coding hybrid ARQ underwater acoustic sensor network model
sources.detail: Uses Urick/Thorp path loss, ambient noise, fading, BPSK BER, and packet error probability from packet length.
